title: Wind Resistant Thermal Break Aluminium Bi Fold Doors Heavy Duty
intro: Wind resistant thermal break aluminium heavy duty folding door is a specialized type of folding or bifold door system that combines the structural strength and modern aesthetic of aluminum with enhanced energy efficiency. The "thermal break" is a crucial feature that addresses a key drawback of traditional aluminum, which is its high thermal conductivity.

title: Space Saving Internal Aluminium Bifold Doors Thermal Insulated Folding Glass Doors External
intro: Space saving thermal insulated aluminium exterior folding door, also known as a "thermally broken" aluminum folding or bifold door, is a modern and energy-efficient solution for creating a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces. These doors are designed to overcome the inherent conductivity of aluminum, which can transfer heat and cold, by incorporating a special insulating technology.
body: The key to a thermal insulated aluminum folding door is the thermal break . Aluminum is a highly conductive material, meaning it easily transfers heat. Without a thermal break, the cold from outside would transfer to the inner frame in winter, and the heat from outside would do the same in summer, leading to energy loss and condensation.

A thermal break is a non-conductive, insulating material often made of a rigid polyamide (a type of plastic) or a specially formulated resin that is inserted between the interior and exterior sections of the aluminum door frame. This break effectively disrupts the path of thermal energy, preventing heat transfer.
